package normalization_adapter

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestEveryResultAndRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	normalizer, err := New()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile("cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []struct {
		Branch string          `json:"branch"`
		Input  string          `json:"input"`
		Value  json.RawMessage `json:"value"`
		Errors Refused         `json:"errors"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(cases) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("empty behavior fixture")
	}
	for index, entry := range cases {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(index), func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Parallel()
			input := []byte(entry.Input)
			before := bytes.Clone(input)
			for repeat := 0; repeat < 2; repeat++ {
				result, err := normalizer.Normalize(entry.Branch, input)
				if entry.Errors != nil {
					// Schema libraries traverse keywords differently; compare every finding,
					// including duplicates, in the Go target's specified pointer order.
					want := append(Refused(nil), entry.Errors...)
					if schemaOnly(want) {
						sort.SliceStable(want, func(i, j int) bool { return want[i].Pointer < want[j].Pointer })
					}
					var refused Refused
					if !errors.As(err, &refused) || !reflect.DeepEqual(refused, want) {
						t.Fatalf("%s %s: got %s %v; want errors %#v", entry.Branch, input, result, err, entry.Errors)
					}
					if result != nil {
						t.Fatal("partial result on refusal")
					}
				} else {
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatalf("%s %s: %v", entry.Branch, input, err)
					}
					got, err := parseInput(result, nil)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					want, err := parseInput(entry.Value, nil)
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
						t.Fatalf("%s %s: got %s; want %s", entry.Branch, input, result, entry.Value)
					}
				}
				if !bytes.Equal(input, before) {
					t.Fatal("caller bytes changed")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func schemaOnly(findings Refused) bool {
	for _, finding := range findings {
		if finding.Rule != "schema_validation" {
			return false
		}
	}
	return len(findings) > 0
}
